manifest_yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: maskrcnn-image-seg
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: image-seg
        image: centaurusinfra/test1_maskrcnn
        command:
        - python
        args:
        - -m
        - torch.distributed.launch
        - --nproc_per_node
        - '2'
        - tools/train_net.py
        - --config-file
        - configs/e2e_mask_rcnn_R_50_FPN_1x.yaml
        - --max_steps
        - '100'
        - OUTPUT_DIR
        - /results
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 2
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /datasets/data
          name: remote-data
        - mountPath: /results
          name: remote-results
        - mountPath: /dev/shm
          name: dshm
      volumes:
      - name: remote-data
        hostPath:
          path: /nfs_1/alnair/pytorch/segmentation/maskrcnn/coco_dataset/
          type: Directory
      - name: remote-results
        hostPath:
          path: /nfs_1/alnair/results
          type: Directory
      - name: dshm
        emptyDir:
          medium: Memory
violation_text: The container "image-seg" is using an invalid container image, "centaurusinfra/test1_maskrcnn". Please use images that are not blocked by the `BlockList` criteria : [".*:(latest)$" "^[^:]*$" "(.*/[^:]+)$"]
